description: Taparia HDC Series - Plus Hammer Drill Bits (Cross Tip) Taparia HDC Series cross tip hammer drill bits are engineered for maximum drilling efficiency in tough masonry materials, delivering professional-grade performance for heavy construction and industrial applications. These advanced concrete drill bits feature superior cross tip geometry and premium tungsten carbide construction for enhanced penetration and extended tool life. Available in comprehensive size range from 6mm to 25mm with lengths up to 600mm, these masonry drill bits incorporate the innovative PLUS shank system for optimal chuck grip and secure connection with hammer drills. The advanced cross tip design ensures faster material removal while the double flute construction eliminates debris buildup during drilling operations. Each SDS hammer drill bit features protective plastic tube packaging to prevent damage during transport and storage. The precision-engineered tungsten carbide cutting edges maintain sharpness through extensive use in concrete, brick, stone, and granite applications. Compatible with all major rotary hammers and hammer drill machines, these professional masonry bits consistently deliver reliable performance for contractors, construction professionals, and serious DIY users. ISO-9001 certified manufacturing ensures consistent quality and durability.
